title: Dial controls and simpler access
summary: This topic combines comments about dial behavior, preferences for simpler physical controls and menu access, easier charging, accessibility for elderly riders, and console-dial glare, so the sample is not a single coherent issue.

positive.summary: The positive feedback says the rotary dial clicks reliably and consistently advances to the next track.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mention preferring simpler click-type controls and easier access, saying charging was simpler than expected, requesting better elderly seat access, and noting sunlight reflection on the console dial without a clear overall sentiment label.

limitations: Most examples are labeled undetermined, which limits clear sentiment conclusions.
The cluster mixes unrelated subjects including infotainment controls, charging ease, seat access, and console glare.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all reviews on this topic.
